name: CYND Co.,Ltd.
summary: CYND Co., Ltd. provides a cloud-based reservation management system primarily for the hairdressing and beauty industry. Its services include online reservation management, a cloud-based medical record function, and an application creation service that allows customers to download store-specific applications from the iPhone App Store and Android Play Store. The company also enables member registration for end customers, facilitating the provision of various services, and supports face-to-face product sales, including consumables such as shampoo and conditioner. Its platform is designed for ease of use regardless of IT literacy and can be accessed from anywhere with an internet connection. The company conducts sales activities through agency partners, mainly targeting beauty-related businesses. It serves hairdressing salons and beauty service providers, operating primarily in Japan. Cynd Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
